## Declared reality

- [ ] Public Present
- [ ] Private Past or Future Lab content is not included

## Public boundary

- [ ] No private infrastructure, runtime topology, paths, repositories, connectors, agent operations, logs, receipts, deployment identifiers, credentials, wallet material, account data or personal information
- [ ] Metrics are public-receipted or clearly synthetic
- [ ] Public provenance and licensing are recorded
- [ ] Security, privacy and accessibility checks pass
- [ ] Rollback is documented
- [ ] Exact-head public-information boundary workflow passes

## Scope

Describe only the public user-facing release unit and its verified evidence.
